native_mirror_before.title: Stable range and block idempotent corner for higher-level Schur-Weyl duality
native_mirror_before.statement: Stable range means at least d Jordan strings have maximum length l, equivalently q_l≥d. For every c this makes the raw H_d(a) action injective. For admissible c outside this range, its image is a central block sum f H_d(a) f; f is the sum of the central blocks supporting contractible simple labels after enlarging all columns to a stable pyramid and deleting the added ground rows. Generalized-eigenvalue sequence idempotents e(i) are not individually central; f is a sum of entire central blocks. Nonadmissible c still has its genuine image algebra and full tensor double centralizer, but the same central-corner/Morita conclusion is not inferred without admissibility.
native_mirror_before.strategy: Assume AC and work over C. The longest-string vector proves stable injectivity on associated graded and hence the filtered algebra. To prove the central-corner clause, enlarge n and every q_j by r, preserving every root a_j; the added bottom entries are c_j+1−(n+k). Let e select degree0 on those rows. Ground minima plus fixed central content force all simple labels in a supporting block to be contractible, and highest-weight PBW shows e kills all other simple blocks. On a supported block, e of the enlarged tensor module is the original tensor module. The original graded first-centralizer argument identifies its W image with the e corner. Under the already-proved stable Morita equivalence this eM is a right progenerator exactly for the supporting central blocks, so its right annihilator is their complement and the image is fHf. Row support and cyclicity are proved by the expanded two-row/induction argument in Specht-corner §§3–4; do not assume e is itself central.

native_mirror_before.title: The degenerate cyclotomic Hecke tower and its residue functors
native_mirror_before.statement: Fix a nonempty consecutive I⊂Z, I^+=I∪(I+1), dominant finite-level Λ=sum_j Λ_mj with m_1≥…≥m_l in the admitted letter alphabet, and Q^+=sum_(i∈I)Z_≥0 alpha_i. Write H_d(m) for the full degenerate cyclotomic algebra. Its polynomial joint spectral projectors e(sequence) select generalized weight summands of arbitrary dimension. For alpha∈Q^+, ht(alpha)=d, put e_alpha=sum_(sequence∈I^d, content=alpha)e(sequence) and H_alpha^Λ=e_alpha H_d(m). Each nonzero content algebra is a SINGLE finite-dimensional block. The degree-d supported tower algebra is f_(I,d)H_d(m), f_(I,d)=sum_(sequence∈I^d)e(sequence); it can be a proper central cut of H_d(m). The locally unital tower is sum_alpha H_alpha^Λ. At level0 take H_0=C and H_d=0 for d>0. Its finite-module G0 has simple basis D(A), A∈Std_alpha, and its split projective K0 has cover basis Y(A), paired perfectly by dim Hom. Project the ambient tower map iota:H_d(m)→H_(d+1)(m) to the content alpha+alpha_i; its identity image is u_(alpha,i)=sum_(last residue=i)e(sequence). Residue restriction is u(−) and induction is H_(alpha+alpha_i)u tensor_(H_alpha)−. They are exact, biadjoint, commute with generator-fixing ordinary duality and shift the content by ±alpha_i. For positive level the ambient maps are the usual inclusions; the level0 convention is treated separately.
native_mirror_before.strategy: Assume AC and work over C. Finite CRT spectral decomposition supplies e(sequence); symmetric Hermite/CRT polynomial projectors separate the finitely many multiset orbits and commute with the affine generators by the divided-difference relation, proving centrality of content sums. Do not infer primitivity from orbit sums alone. Realize the same charges stably with q_j=m_j+1−k≥d and common admissible origin c=m_1; n=q_1 gives c+q_j−n=m_j. The actual17 stable Hecke component equals End_O(T_alpha)^op. The actual16 fixed-content parabolic category is one linkage block. Choose a FULL projective generator Q containing T_alpha, set A=End_O(Q)^op and H=eAe. By actual17 ALL-projective full faithfulness, End_O(Q)=End_H(pi Q). Central h∈H acts naturally on pi Q; full faithfulness lifts it to Z(A), and restriction to pi T=H recovers h. A central lift vanishing on T vanishes on Hom(T,Q), hence on Q by faithfulness. Thus Z(A)=Z(H), so H has no nontrivial central idempotent and is one block. The actual17 contraction/corner proof shows every I-supported content survives the stable auxiliary enlargement: new bottom occupancy is maximal in all columns, top occupancy0, so all labels are contractible. This proves the supported statement without equating it with the whole degree. Exact residue maps/functors and duality are the actual17 supplier, restricted by these central cuts. Simple/projective bases and Hom duality use the declared finite-algebra Grothendieck suppliers. The focused proof §1 expands this complete missing centre argument; I={0},m=(0),d=2 has supported component0 although full H_2=C[S_2]. The commutative polynomial algebra satisfies the actual CRT supplier hypotheses: distinct spectral characters differ by a nonzero complex coordinate, so their maximal ideals and sufficiently high powers are pairwise comaximal; a finite uniform nilpotence bound gives the required projectors on the regular module.
